authorization_scope: Lean specification, non-production feasibility probes, architecture and blockers. No production service/frontend or deployment.

foundations.sat_backend: SAT4J initially; native backends require separate validation
foundations.rust_m0: 1.100.0 portable rustc/std Windows MSVC; no Cargo dependency/build pipeline established

decisions.decision: Rust is the algorithmic authority. Compiled Lean is the pinned external parser dependency; Java17 is the Alloy API bridge only.
Use typed bag-aware relational IR plus separate effect/transaction IR. Lists in Lean model occurrences; bag equivalence ignores order. Ordered query results require their own contract.

Use separately parsed statements in a transaction envelope. Statement-local typed parameters, explicit actor/session/catalog, no hidden application control flow and no concurrent transactions in the first profile.

Model commit and abort explicitly; preserve prior observations and exact write frames. Enforced constraints select outcomes rather than erase failing transitions. Unsupported triggers/RLS/default effects block analysis.

Require assumptions, execution reachability, semantic coverage and completed failure search. A solver summary is not a Lean proof. SAT witness soundness and UNSAT failure completeness are separate obligations.

Finite-input numeric profile uses enough internal arithmetic range for all admitted intermediate calculations. SQL type-range errors are explicit. noOverflow=true may be used only with an independent adequacy check; it is not a model of SQL overflow.

Use occurrence-preserving structural output slots, not arbitrary result-atom limits. Projection has one slot per input, product/join allocates all pair candidates, UNION ALL uses tagged disjoint slots; outer joins reserve unmatched slots.
decisions.gate: The complete allocation/activation semantics and its preservation argument remain M1 work; excessive capacities are INCONCLUSIVE, never UNSAT.

decisions.decision: Versioned bounded UTF8 JSON over private child-process pipes; explicit argument APIs, no SQL or keys in command-line arguments. Supervised worker process isolation before untrusted hosting.
Deterministic typed-IR-to-SQL and typed-IR-to-Alloy compilation. Reverse decoding accepts only generated packages with intact provenance; arbitrary Alloy has no SQL inverse.

Render validated solver instances deterministically as tables, graphs and transaction-step views; attach separately validated AI annotations. Show satisfying examples and counterexamples with distinct labels.

Adopt AlloyStudio's separation of solver-derived visualization and AI explanation as a reference pattern. Build SQLolla's browser BYOT and provider adapters separately; do not assume AlloyStudio provides them.
Cloudflare hosts static UI/ingress; a VM/container/native origin hosts Rust, Lean and Java. Private/offline operation uses the same core without required Cloudflare or provider calls.

Every formal module is imported into the aggregate and audited by module ownership. No placeholders, custom axioms, unsafe declarations or compiler-trust shortcuts; only listed Lean foundations may occur transitively.

rules: Unknown node tags fail closed
Numbers preserve lexemes and magnitudes without float conversion
NULL differs from missing syntax
Positional parameters and ALL flags are retained
Statement-level source map until finer spans are validated
Process exit zero alone does not imply supported SQL
Only generated Alloy and pinned modules
No stderr content interpreted as result
Empty/malformed output is engine failure
No externally reachable Java port
Retain raw solver-instance provenance
Relations retain arity and tuple position; not just binary graph edges
Duplicate SQL values remain distinct occurrences
Explicit NULL representation
Aborted transaction is distinct from no-op commit
No synthetic graph facts generated by the LLM
Unvalidated solver models are labeled candidate instances
A filtered, truncated or redacted projection cannot justify absence of omitted facts; retain completeness flags at each boundary.
Separate from immutable instance payload
All references resolve against that exact instance
Reference membership does not prove prose truthful
Show proposed edits and rerun after acceptance
Never change formal verdict, policy or scope implicitly

modes: Explore a satisfying example of assumptions/execution
Find a counterexample to a named property
graph_rules: Derive nodes and edges only from validated tuple data
Use tuple nodes/hyperedges or tables for arity >2
Hover or click highlights exact evidence/source references
Escape all identifiers/values; sanitize explanation Markdown
Keep full-evidence, transport and view completeness independent; require retained complete evidence for replayability claims.
instance_experience.enumeration: Bound number of instances and job lifetime. Continuations are owner-scoped and bound to model/query/policy/bounds hashes; no completeness claim from a finite displayed sample.
instance_experience.explanations: Every displayed instance can request a grounded AI explanation when BYOT is configured. Without a token/provider availability, retain the instance with a deterministic summary and a clear optional-AI control.
instance_experience.privacy: Preview/redact outbound instance facts and get sharing consent for sensitive content. Tokens stay out of graphs, checkpoints, logs and report exports.
status_language: No counterexample found within these bounds
instance_experience.formal_boundary: Instance.lean specifies authenticity of selected facts and justification of counterexample labels. It does not prove the visual renderer or natural-language explanation correct.

trust_policy.enforcement: formal/verify.ps1 source inventory + default Lake target TrustAudit using Lean.collectAxioms and direct axiom/unsafe checks
trust_policy.scope: All declarations belonging to imported SQLolla modules, including private/generated declarations; all formal source modules must appear in the aggregate.
trust_policy.limits: Not a sandbox for malicious metaprograms; trusts verified toolchain/kernel. Explicit proof premises and contract fields are future obligations, not proved compiler facts.
